name: Fanvue
description: Fanvue lets agents read earnings, subscribers, messages, and posts in the signed-in Fanvue creator account. Each user signs in to their own Fanvue account through the browser.

prompts.text: How did my earnings this month compare with last month?
Which subscriber messages are still waiting for a reply?
Draft a caption for a post that announces my new weekly schedule.

apps.name: Fanvue
apps.description: Earnings, subscriber, message, and post access, over Fanvue's MCP server with browser sign-in.
